query: SELECT reasoning_depth, evaluation_dataset, generator_model FROM cspaper WHERE (reasoning_depth != 'multi-hop' AND multi_turn_retrieval = 'Yes') OR (performance_on_NQ = 'Ideal Setting (4√+1x): Qwen1.5-7B (EM: 29.10, F1 score: 41.02); Llama2-13B (EM: 33.60, F1 score: 44.62); Llama3-8B (EM: 36.90, F1 score: 48.45). GPT Setting (4√+1x): Qwen1.5-7B (EM: 23.10, F1 score: 34.84); Llama2-13B (EM: 25.10, F1 score: 35.56); Llama3-8B (EM: 30.70, F1 score: 41.71).' AND performance_on_NQ = 'TeaRAG-8B: EM: 50.06; F1: 59.71; TeaRAG-14B: EM: 50.33; F1: 60.31');
note: SQL本身只有结构化算子；SExtract是从原文到关系的分析性补充，不是源SQL的显式调用，也不表明每个字段必须由LLM抽取。字段类型、NULL及一对多抽取契约须在执行前固定。
